vb_textbox.text: The advice given to me was to select the purple and green gnomes (who give yellow basket) to get more mushrooms then when numbers for the yellow basket drop choose the other gnomes (red basket) until that one drops. I don't think this works. It is not to do with the gnome standing left or right either. I would look for another pattern or something in the background. It might be entirely random of course. I am hopeless at pattern spotting so don't take anything I say as 100% accurate!
